title: Wison breaks ground on key ADNOC Gas facility in Abu Dhabi

ADNOC Gas plc today announced that its shares have been selected for inclusion in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index after successfully meeting the MSCI’s established eligibility criteria. Image courtesy: ADNOC Image used for illustrative purpose.

A major unit of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, ADNOC Gas had awarded Wison Engineering the $3.9bln EPC contract in August

Staff Writer ,  TradeArabia

Wison Engineering, a leading provider of EPC services and integrated technology solutions for the energy and chemical industries, has broken ground on the new natural gas processing train at the Habshan facility in Abu Dhabi, thus marking the start of construction for Phase 2 of ADNOC Gas' Rich Gas Development (RGD) Project.

A major unit of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, ADNOC Gas had awarded Wison Engineering the $3.9 billion EPC contract in August.

Together with an associated 220kV switch station, the total contract value is approximately $4.04 billion, making it Wison's largest EPC project to date.

The project will add a new large-scale gas processing train at Habshan. Once completed, it will increase the ADNOC unit's gas processing capacity and operational flexibility, thus supporting the continued development of the UAE's downstream and petrochemical industries.

As the main contractor, Wison Engineering said it will bring together its integrated EPC expertise, execution excellence and global supply-chain resources to deliver the new gas processing train including the project's key gas treatment and deep NGL recovery facilities.

"The groundbreaking marks the project's transition into full construction. We greatly value the trust ADNOC Gas has placed in Wison and the close collaboration between our teams,” remarked Hongliang Zhou, Chief Executive Officer. 

“As the project moves forward, we will maintain a strong focus on safety, quality and disciplined execution, working closely with ADNOC Gas and our partners to advance key milestones and deliver the project successfully,” stated Zhou.

Engineering, procurement and site preparation activities have been progressing since the project launch. With construction now under way, on-site activities will continue to ramp up as Habshan facility moves into its next phase of execution.

The Habshan facility expansion comes as part of Phase 2 of ADNOC Gas' RGD Project, which will add a new natural gas processing train to expand processing capacity, enhance operational flexibility and support the UAE's growing downstream and petrochemical sectors. 

The project also strengthens Wison Engineering's experience and delivery capabilities in large-scale international EPC projects in the Middle East, it added.
